The Flintstones attempted genocide of my people, and we have barely been able to recover, to our former numbers. Flintstone Vitamins have been just some of the many attempts to normalize their actions. I understand that people may not know the full history of the atrocities, but please don't trivialize the Flintstones, or their actions.

So @Gravspeed, I advise you to tell any Centaurs you see that you're sorry. Don't dismiss any of their concerns, or try to justify you're mistakes, just listen and believe. It still still hurts many members of our culture, and probably always will.
